description: License classes for per-record SPDX labeling and partitioned packaging. 'license' fields hold an SPDX id or one of the pseudo-ids below. An identifier may be listed under more than one class (e.g. a share-alike non-commercial id); it then holds every class it is listed under (rules[3]).

public-domain.obligations: none for the SPDX ids. US-GOV-PD: public domain in the United States (17 U.S.C. §105); status elsewhere is the consumer's to assess; credit the issuing agency as it asks

share-alike.obligations: viral per record: ships only in share-alike-labeled partitions; derived open datasets inherit

non-commercial.obligations: no commercial use: never admitted into a pack, export, release, corpus or training set whose use is commercial, nor into one that feeds such use; outside the default consumer allowlist

proprietary.obligations: owner-scoped use only (e.g. a world producer's generated-world exports); never in open releases

personal.obligations: the user's own data; follows the personal tier containment rules

rules: A record with an unknown/blank license, or one whose identifier is listed under no class, is INVALID at every boundary — producers must resolve, never default silently.

Pack/export license manifests must partition counts by class; consumers reject classes outside their configured allowlist with a per-record report. A record holding more than one class is counted under each, so per-class counts may sum to more than the record count.

An identifier listed under more than one class holds every class it is listed under. A record is admitted only if every class it holds is on the consumer's allowlist, and an admitted record carries the obligations of every class it holds.
A record labelled US-GOV-PD MUST carry provenance.source_url naming the issuing agency's own public-domain statement; a consumer treats a US-GOV-PD record without one as unlabelled (the first rule).
